x: In the Junior race Eddie Short again ran well and although having a couple of falls down the "shute," he was our first man home in 13th place. C.
We were pleased to welcome the Mayor of Malden to our Hall, also the Deputy Mayor, our old friend, Teddy Gordon, and a field of about 16 runners faced the starter. The winner was C.

Our time on that occasion was 1hr. 30min. 27secs., and as our team was minus three of last year's team, we hoped to win again, but were not too sure. Our lads, however, rose to the occasion in fine style and with C.
Our first counter was Steve Charlton who finished 4th, and we were pleased to see Les. Stokell turning out for us once again, and he ran well in being 7th, as did C.
Full placings and team positions are given below:— 5th Belgrave "A" (C.

As the age limit for this race is 21 years, we are indeed pleased to see such a good number competing and among these were several newcomers to our ranks and we wish them every success in their athletic endeavours. The winner of a good race was C.

Held at Banstead on January 7th over a two-lap course and our lads did very well to gain third team position, against the strong South London side and a Herne Hill team, strengthened by the inclusion of two Reading A.C. members. C.
Courtney and it looks as if we have the makings of some good boys among these youngsters. C.

Our team placing was fifth which was quite a big improvement on last year and as 37 teams were competing, our lads can be said to have done very well. Scoring positions of our lads are as follows:—22, C.
